run_visualize_json_results: run the script to visualize COCO or LVIS JSON predictions as side-by-side images
run_create_instances: run create_instances to convert raw prediction dicts into a Detectron2 Instances object
run_main_coco: run main to load COCO predictions JSON and generate visualization images in an output directory
run_main_lvis: run main with an LVIS dataset name to visualize LVIS predictions with category id mapping
review_create_instances: review create_instances to understand how predictions are filtered by confidence threshold and converted to Boxes
